candidates.current_role: Brazoria County Criminal District Attorney since October 2020
candidates.background: Tom Selleck, of Angleton, was appointed Brazoria County Criminal District Attorney by Governor Greg Abbott effective October 1, 2020. Before the appointment he owned The Law Office of Tom Selleck, P.C. and served as a deputy sheriff with the Brazoria County Sheriff's Department. He holds a bachelor's degree in criminology from Florida State University and a law degree from South Texas College of Law.

record.text: In August 2021 his office reported receiving allegations of irregularities in the county's jury selection process and asked the Texas Rangers to investigate; the Rangers confirmed in October 2021 that the investigation was ongoing.

notes.text: Won the Republican nomination for Criminal District Attorney in 2026 as the incumbent and faces Democrat Bianca Santorini in November.

At his 2020 appointment he was listed as a member of the State Bar of Texas, the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, The Federalist Society, and the Brazoria County Bar Association, and as board chair of the Angleton Area Emergency Medical Corps.
Branch reported that as of July 2026 he did not have a campaign website.
